##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 09 August 2026 at 4:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over eastern Europe and low pressure to the east of Iceland as a frontal zone affects the north of the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5, soon veering north or northwest 3 to 5 early evening. Decreasing 2 to 4 Monday morning, becoming variable in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain at first becoming fair later this evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, becoming east or southeast 3 or 4 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
